Container.Name: morning-current
Container.Overview: The Morning Current makes a printed morning newspaper every night from RSS feeds you choose: full stories from public-domain and Creative Commons sources, headlines and QR codes for the rest, an almanac computed for your town, and a page of fresh puzzles (crossword, sudoku, cryptogram and more). It lays the paper out as a fold-in-half booklet, checks every page, and can print it on a schedule through CUPS. Everything runs without AI; add an Anthropic API key to have Claude write and research stories. Open the web UI and follow the setup wizard.
Container.Requires: A printer shared over CUPS/IPP is optional; papers can also be read in the browser, emailed or copied to a folder.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Press room, settings and the public reader

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, editions, the article database and logs. To keep a Morning Press archive, point this at its appdata folder (it is upgraded in place).

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Sign-in for the press room. If blank, one is generated and printed in the container log.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional: lets Claude write and research stories (can also be entered in Settings > AI)

Config.Name: CUPS server
Config.Description: Optional print server, host:631 (can also be set in Settings > Schedule & delivery)

Config.Name: Push token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token for the API (push finished editions, trigger builds). Leave blank to disable the API.

Config.Name: Output folder
Config.Description: Optional: set Settings > Schedule & delivery > Copy PDFs to folder to /output to get every paper here

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the data folder

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the data folder

Config.Name: Time zone (logs)
Config.Description: Log timestamps only; the paper's own time zone is chosen in the setup wizard

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookie
Config.Description: true if you only reach the app over https (reverse proxy)
